items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The achaierai makes two attacks with its Talons and one attack with its Beak.

items.name: Beak
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

items.name: Talons
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

items.name: Spring Attack
items.notes: The achaierai takes the Disengage action.

items.name: Defensive Cloud
items.notes: After taking damage the achaierai can use its reaction to release a cloud of poisonous gas in a 10-foot-radius. All creatures in the cloud take 7 (2d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned the target is confused as if from a confusion spell. At the end of its turns, the affected target can repeat the Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds the confusion ends. Achaierai are immune to the effects of this cloud.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The achaierai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Aribeth casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

conditional.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Aribeth makes three Void or Unholy Strike attacks.

items.name: Void
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from damage dealt by the sword Void dies and can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.

items.name: Unholy Strike
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

items.name: Parry
items.notes: Aribeth adds 4 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Aribeth must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

items.name: Infernal Tracker
items.notes: Aribeth knows the distance to and direction of any creature that has broken a pact with Mephistopheles, even if the creature and Aribeth are on different planes of existence.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Aribeth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Nightmare
items.notes: Aribeth is accompanied by a nightmare. The nightmare allows Aribeth to use it as a mount.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: Aribeth regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If Aribeth takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Aribeth's next turn. Aribeth's body is destroyed only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Shadows
items.notes: Three shadow hide within the saddle of Aribeth's nightmare. These shadows only come out if there is a creature within 30 feet that is at 0 hit points. When that happens, a shadow emerges and attacks the creature in order to make it fail a death saving throw. It continues to do so until the creature is dead.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, Aribeth has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Baalzebul casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Baalzebul uses Heart of Pestilence (if available), then makes three Slam attacks.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

items.name: Pungent Eruption
items.notes: Baalzebul causes refuse and caustic liquid to spill from the ground at a point he can see within 300 feet. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 36 (8d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save have the poisoned condition for 1 minute.

items.name: Heart of Pestilence
items.notes: Baalzebul channels pestilence into his body, sickening creatures within 50 feet that can see him. Sickened creatures must make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, followed by a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Failing the Charisma save makes a creature have the frightened condition, while failing the Constitution save makes a creature weak. While weakened, a creature deals half damage on melee attacks. Both effects last for 1 minute or until a greater restoration spell or similar is cast.

items.name: Displace
items.notes: Baalzebul magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede Baalzebul's darkvision.

items.name: Fiendish Regeneration
items.notes: Baalzebul regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Baalzebul dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Lord of Flies
items.notes: Insects don't attack Baalzebul, and he can issue orders to them.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Baalzebul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Baalzebul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Stench of the Slug
items.notes: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Baalzebul must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

items.name: Pummel
items.notes: Baalzebul makes a Slam attack.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Baalzebul uses Displace.

items.name: Insect Gorge
items.notes: Baalzebul disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point he can see within 300 feet of himself. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 44 (8d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The biting flies persist for 1 minute, or until Baalzebul uses this ability again. Creatures that enter the flies' area or end their turn inside it must repeat the saving throw.

items.name: Call Underling
items.notes: Baalzebul summons an allied bone devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

name: Bebilith
languages: understands Abyssal but only speaks telepathically to its own kind

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The bebilith uses Poisoned Web (if available) and then makes one Bite attack and two Foreleg attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage. Any creature that drops to zero hit points because of this attack ignites, suffering 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until the creature's hit points are above zero.

items.name: Foreleg
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Poisoned Web
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 51 (10d8 + 6) poison damage, and the target has the restrained condition until free of the web. While restrained, the target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target may use an action to make a DC 17 Strength check and if successful they are freed from the webbing. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; 10 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, fire, poison, and psychic damage). If an attack or spell doing fire damage is used on the webbing, the webbing ignites (but is otherwise unharmed). Any creature restrained by the webbing suffers an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turn.

items.name: Stalker's Darkness
items.notes: The bebilith casts darkness.

items.name: Relentless Hunter
items.notes: The bebilith may use a bonus action to mark prey that it has damaged. Only one creature can be marked at a time. The bebilith always knows the exact location of the marked prey on the current plane of existence, can't be surprised by it, and has advantage on all attack rolls against it.

items.name: Dark Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede the bebilith's darkvision.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down, without needing to make an ability check and ignores any movement restrictions caused by webbing.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The ravager makes one Bite attack and then either two Claw attacks or two Spines attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Large or smaller creatures damaged by this attack are grappled (escape DC 20) and the ravager can't make another Bite attack until this grapple ends.

items.name: Spines
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage. If the target fails a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

items.name: Avatar of Bhaal
items.notes: When the ravager drops to 0 hit points, its form fractures. Within the next 24 hours, it will reappear in its slayer form within 2d6 miles of where the ravager form fell.

items.name: Cull the Weak
items.notes: When the ravager damages a creature with a melee attack and the target is left with 20 or fewer remaining hit points, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points.

items.name: Immutable Form
items.notes: The ravager is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the ravager fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The ravager has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
items.notes: The ravager's Claw, Bite, and Spines attacks are magical.

items.name: Spiked Hide
items.notes: At the start of each of its turns, the ravager deals 16 (3d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it or being grappled by it.

items.name: Detect
items.notes: The ravager makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

items.name: Spiky Carapace
items.notes: The ravager flares its numerous spines and they elongate. Any creature within 5 feet of the ravager must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Smash (Costs 2 Actions)
items.notes: The ravager smashes downwards with great force, causing a violent implosion. Any creature within 10 feet of the ravager must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are also pulled 5 feet towards the ravager. The noise produced by this attack can be heard up to 1 mile away.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The slayer makes four Claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

items.name: Prey
items.notes: The slayer focuses on a single creature it can see within 60 feet. Afterwards, the first time each turn that the slayer hits that creature, the slayer does an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

items.name: Assassinate
items.notes: During its first turn, the slayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the slayer scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede the slayer's darkvision.

items.name: Immutable Form
items.notes: The slayer is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, except for its Ravager Form ability.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the slayer fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The slayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
items.notes: The slayer's claw attacks are magical.

items.name: Savage Disengage
items.notes: The slayer disengages without provoking opportunity attacks. If it moves within 5 feet of a creature it makes a Claw attack against the creature.

items.name: Finish (Costs 2 Actions)
items.notes: The slayer attacks a creature that has been marked by its Prey ability. If this attack hits and the creature has less than 40 hit points remaining after the attack, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points.

items.name: Ravager Form (Costs 3 Actions)
items.notes: If the slayer has killed a creature of CR/level 5 or greater that it previously marked with its Prey ability in the last minute, it can transform into its Bhaal, Ravager. The form lasts until dawn (minimum 1 hour).

items.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
items.notes: Bodhi makes three Unarmed Strike attacks, one of which can be a Bite attack instead.

items.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Bodhi can grapple a Medium-sized or smaller target (escape DC 18).

items.name: Bite (Panther or Vampire Form Only)
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Bodhi regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Bodhi's control.

items.name: Change Shape
items.notes: If Bodhi isn't in sunlight, she can polymorph into a Medium panther or back into her true form. While in panther form, Bodhi Irenicus can't speak, her walking speed is 40 feet, and she has a climb speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

items.name: Charm
items.notes: Bodhi targets one Humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see Bodhi, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Bodhi. The charmed target regards Bodhi as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Bodhi's control, it takes Bodhi's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time Bodhi or her allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Bodhi is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Bodhi fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: Bodhi regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn.

items.name: Rejuvenation
items.notes: If Bodhi is destroyed, her body immediately appears in her resting place. She is paralyzed until she regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 24 hours in her resting place with 0 hit points, she regains 1 hit point. While paralyzed in this manner, if a creature within 60 feet says her name 9 times, Bodhi is permanently destroyed.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.notes: Bodhi deals an extra 28 (8d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Bodhi that isn't incapacitated and Bodhi doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: Bodhi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Summoned By Name
items.notes: If a creature says Bodhi Irenicus's full name 9 times in a row, Bodhi hears her name and becomes aware of the creature. Bodhi knows the exact location and name of the creature that spoke her name. She can then choose, as a free action, to teleport to a location adjacent to the creature. She must choose to do this within 1 minute of hearing her name. This power works even if the creature is on a different plane of existence. 1 minute after teleporting, Bodhi teleports back to where she was located when she heard her name spoken. This occurs even if Bodhi is unwilling and even if she is in an antimagic effect.

items.name: Vampire Weaknesses
items.notes:
Bodhi Irenicus has the following flaws:

Elvish Song
Bodhi can't abide a song performed in the elvish language. A creature that can speak the elvish language can use an action to sing an elven song. If Bodhi is within 60 feet of the singer and can hear the song, she has disadvantage on attacks and saving throws.

Stake to the Heart
If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Bodhi's heart while she is incapacitated in her resting place, Bodhi is paralyzed until the stake is removed.

Sunlight Hypersensitivity
Bodhi takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

items.name: Move
items.notes: Bodhi moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

items.name: Unarmed Strike
items.notes: Bodhi makes one Unarmed Strike.

items.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
items.notes: Bodhi makes one Bite attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Borivik casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Borivik makes two Shortsword attacks or two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Crossbow Expert
items.notes: Borivik adds 1d10 to his next attack or damage roll with his Heavy Crossbow attack.

items.name: Nimble Escape
items.notes: Borivik can take the Disengage or Hide action.

items.name: Enduring Response
items.notes: When Borivik takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, he gains immunity to that damage type until the start of his next turn. Also, the first time he hits with a Shortsword attack on his next turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) of the triggering damage type.

items.name: Bolts of Undead Slaying
items.notes: Borivik has a half-dozen bolts of undead slaying. If he strikes an Undead creature with one of these magic bolts, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 33 (6d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Doc Watson casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Doc Watson makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

items.name: Arcane Burst
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) lightning damage.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Doc Watson has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Portent
items.notes: When Doc Watson or a creature he can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, Doc Watson can roll a d20 and choose to use this roll in place of the attack roll, saving throw, or ability check. This trait recharges after using the Spellcasting action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Cryonax casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Cryonax makes two Slam attacks with his tentacles or two Ice Spear attacks.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). Cryonax can grapple up to two targets but any tentacle that is grappling can't be used to make a Slam or Ice Spear attack.

items.name: Ice Spear
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d10 + 3) cold damage.

items.name: Summon Frost Horde
items.notes: Cryonax summons two young white dragons or a frost giant with two yetis. The summoning costs Cryonax 50 hit points. The summoned creatures have maximum hit points and appear within 100 feet of Cryonax.

items.name: Cold Aura
items.notes: At the start of each of Cryonax's turns, each creature within 10 feet of him takes 21 (6d6) cold damage. A creature also takes 21 (6d6) cold damage if they touch or hit Cryonax. Nonmagical weapons that hit Cryonax are frozen immediately after dealing damage to Cryonax. If used again and they hit any creature, the weapon shatters. The freezing effect disappears after an hour.

items.name: Empowered Attacks
items.notes: Cryonax's Slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical weapons.

items.name: Ice Walker
items.notes: No ability checks are required when Cryonax walks or climbs across icy surfaces and difficult snow or ice terrain does not cost him extra movement.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Cryonax fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Cryonax has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Smash
items.notes: Cryonax slams a grappled target against the ground, dealing 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage to it.

items.name: Tentacle Freeze
items.notes: Cryonax's tentacle freezes a grappled target. If the target fails a DC 22 Constitution saving throw they are paralyzed and Cryonax releases them from its tentacle. They remain frozen indefinitely but can attempt the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns. Success means they are no longer frozen.

items.name: Ice Shroud (Costs 3 Actions)
items.notes: With a gesture Cryonax targets a frozen creature (see Tentacle Freeze) that is within 30 feet of him. The target is encased instantly in a hard shell of crushing ice. The target receives no saving throw and takes 22 (5d8) cold damage immediately and at the start of each of their turns. The target is considered stunned but is partly protected by the shroud and resistant to all damage. The shroud disappears if Cryonax removes it, Cryonax dies, the shroud takes 100 hit points of damage or another character uses their action and succeeds on a DC 22 Strength check to remove the trapped ally.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Dagryn casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Club
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Eruption
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) acid damage.

items.name: Invisibility
items.notes: Dagryn magically turns invisible for 1 hour or until he attacks or casts a spell. Any equipment Dagryn wears or carries turns invisible with him. Recharges after a Short or Long Rest.

items.name: Draconic Transformation
items.notes: When Dagryn drops to 0 hit points, instead of falling unconscious, he transforms into his dragon form. He immediately gains all the statistics of an adult black dragon with the exception that his size is Medium, and has the stunned condition. At the start of his next turn, he grows to Large size, but remains stunned. At the start of his subsequent turn, Dagryn grows to Huge size and is no longer stunned. Dagryn remains in his dragon form for 24 hours whereupon he reverts to this stat block.

items.name: Dwarven Resilience
items.notes: Dagryn has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Darien casts one of the following spells, requiring no material component and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Darien makes two War Pick attacks.

items.name: War Pick
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 necrotic damage.

items.name: Eldritch Blast
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 300 ft., three targets. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage.

items.name: Create Thrall
items.notes: Darien touches an incapacitated Humanoid. That creature is then charmed by her until a remove curse spell is cast on it, the charmed condition is removed from it, or she uses this feature again. Darien can communicate telepathically with the charmed creature as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

items.name: Summon War Pick
items.notes: Darien creates a magical war pick in her empty hand. The war pick counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. The war pick has a +1 bonus to attack and damage (already factored into Darien's attacks).

items.name: Shield of Cryonax
items.notes: When Darien takes damage, she can entomb herself in ice, which melts away at the end of her next turn. She gains 150 temporary hit points, which take as much of the triggering damage as possible. Immediately after she takes the damage, she gains vulnerability to fire damage, her speed is reduced to 0, and she is incapacitated. These effects, including any remaining temporary hit points, all end when the ice melts.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Darien can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet

items.name: Eldritch Mind
items.notes: Darien has advantage on Constitution saving throws that she makes to maintain concentration on a spell.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The deep spider makes one Bite attack and two Foreleg attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and has the paralyzed condition while poisoned in this way.

items.name: Foreleg
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The deep spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Web Sense
items.notes: While in contact with a web, the deep spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

items.name: Web Walker
items.notes: The deep spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The dread doppelganger casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The dread doppelganger makes three Slam attacks.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6).

items.name: Read Thoughts
items.notes: The dread doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft. of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the dread doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the dread doppelganger's Concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

items.name: Ambusher

As a bonus action, Minsc talks to Boo and gains the inspiration to go into a berserker fury, for 1 minute. While in this berserking fury Minsc gains the following:

Minsc has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
Minsc gains a +4 bonus to damage rolls when using a melee weapon.
Minsc has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Minsc can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of his turns.
Minsc can't be charmed or frightened. If Minsc is charmed or frightened when he enters his berserking fury, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage
If Minsc drops to 0 hit points and doesn't die outright, he can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If he succeeds, he drops to 1 hit point instead. Each time he uses this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. After 24 hours, the DC resets to 10.

items.name: Run, Boo, Run
items.notes: If Boo takes damage, Minsc can choose to take the damage instead.

items.name: Boo, The Miniature Giant Space Hamster
items.notes: Boo is Minsc's animal companion. Boo is a miniature giant space hamster and has the statistics of a rat.

items.name: Favored Enemy
items.notes: Minsc's favored enemy is evil. When he hits an evil creature with a melee attack he deals an additional 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

items.name: Reckless
items.notes: At the start of his turn, Minsc may choose to gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Montaron makes three Shortsword attacks and uses the ability Unleash the Demilich if available.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Unleash the Demilich
items.notes: Montaron reaches inside his bag of holding and releases Xzar. Xzar is a demilich and appears within 5 feet of Montaron. Xzar rolls for his own initiative. Xzar can't use lair actions or legendary actions. He has a CR of 14.

items.name: Assassinate
items.notes: During his first turn, Montaron has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Montaron scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

items.name: Evasion
items.notes: If Montaron is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Montaron instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

items.name: Nimbleness
items.notes: Montaron can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than his.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.notes: Montaron deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Montaron that isn't incapacitated and Montaron doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Montaron possesses a bag of holding. He keeps the demilich, Xzar, in the bag. He also possesses a portable hole, which he uses to aid in robberies. As a bonus action, Montaron can place his portable hole in his bag of holding. This instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. Montaron and any creature within 10 feet of him is sucked through the gate to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Naes casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

items.name: Mace
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage.

items.name: Corona of Beauty
items.notes: Naes activates an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until he dismisses it using an action. He emits bright light in a 60-foot-radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that. His enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.

items.name: Radiant Beauty of Sune
items.notes: Naes dispels any magical darkness within 30 feet of him. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of Naes that does not have Cover must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 60 radiant damage on a failed saving throw, half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw has the blinded condition for 1 minute.

items.name: Hard to Kill
items.notes: If Naes would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, or is subjected to an effect that would kill him instantaneously without doing damage, Naes instead drops to 1 hit point.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Nauk makes three Magic Maul attacks. Nauk may substitute one of those attacks for the Imbibe Potion action.

items.name: Magic Maul
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Imbibe Potion
items.notes: Nauk drinks a potion from the following list: Potion of heroism: Nauk gains 10 temporary hit points for 1 hour. For the same duration, Nauk is under the effect of the bless spell (no concentration required). Potion of resistance: Nauk gains resistance from one damage type for 1 hour. Nauk chooses from one of these damage types: cold, fire, lightning. Potion of superior healing: Nauk regains 28 hit points.

items.name: Parry
items.notes: Nauk adds 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Nauk must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

items.name: Potion Mishap
items.notes: When Nauk uses the Imbibe Potion action more than once in an hour, roll 1d4 for what happens: 1. The potion works normally. 2. The potion works normally. In addition, Nauk turns invisible for 1 minute or until Nauk attacks or casts a spell. 3. The potion has no effect. 4. Instead of the normal effect, the potion causes fire to explode out of Nauk's mouth in a 15 foot cone. Nauk and any creature in the cone take 21 (6d6) fire damage.

items.name: Relentless
items.notes: When Nauk is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he can drop to 1 hit point instead. He can't use this feature again for 24 hours

items.name: Special Items
items.notes: Nauk wears adamantine plate armor. He wields a +1 maul and a +1 heavy crossbow which is already factored into his stats. He has 2 potions of resistance (cold), 2 potions of resistance (fire), 2 potions of resistance (lightning). He has 2 potions of heroism and 4 potions of superior healing.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Pazuzu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 24):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Pazuzu makes two Greatsword or Talon attacks.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

items.name: Talon
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

items.name: Breath Weapons
items.notes: Pazuzu exhales poisonous acid in a 100-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Every creature hit by the acid must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this breath weapon melts and is disintegrated.

items.name: Dispel
items.notes: Pazuzu casts dispel magic, automatically dispelling any spell of 6th level or lower on the target.

items.name: Hasted Greatsword
items.notes: Pazuzu uses his magic greatsword to grant him the following abilities until the start of his next turn. Pazuzu's speed is now doubled, he gains a +2 bonus to AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and gains one additional Greatsword attack.

items.name: Aura of Servile Avians
items.notes: Any evil creature with a natural fly speed and a CR of 20 or less must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw if they attempt to attack Pazuzu. A failed save means their action is wasted and the attack fails. On a successful saving throw the target is immune to this effect in the future.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Pazuzu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
items.notes: Pazuzu's weapon attacks are magical.

items.name: Disarm
items.notes: Pazuzu attempts to knock a weapon out of a target's hand. He makes a Greatsword attack and if it hits, the target does not take damage but instead must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. If the target fails the saving throw, the targeted weapon flies 10 feet away in a random direction.

items.name: Lethal Leap
items.notes: Pazuzu attacks once with his Greatsword or Talon and then may fly up to 60 feet away. Pazuzu's movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Pelyious casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):

conditional.note: damage from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

items.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form)
items.notes: In Humanoid form, Pelyious makes two Scimitar attacks or two Hand Crossbow attacks. In hybrid form, he can substitute one Scimitar attack for a Bite attack.

items.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or Hybrid Form)
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

items.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form)
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

items.name: Bite (Hybrid Form Only)
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Pelyious can't Bite another target.

items.name: Change Shape
items.notes: Pelyious polymorphs into a crocodile-humanoid hybrid, or back into his true form, which is Humanoid. His statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

items.name: Slippery Step
items.notes: Pelyious teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and may use Change Shape.

items.name: Hold Breath
items.notes: Pelyious can hold his breath for 15 minutes.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The phaerimm makes four Claw attacks and then makes a Bite or Stinger attack. Alternatively, it uses Spellcasting and then makes two Claw attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

items.name: Stinger
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target fails a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, they have the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. The phaerimm's poison forces the paralyzed target to float 5 feet above the ground. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of it's turns.

items.name: Implant
items.notes: The phaerimm makes a Stinger attack against a paralyzed target. If the stinger hits, an egg is implanted in the target. This egg can only be removed by spells that cure disease, such as lesser restoration. If the egg is not removed within 90 days, the larva emerges, and the host is killed. A phaerimm has a single egg so may only use this ability once.

items.name: Arcane Sight
items.notes: The phaerimm discerns the location of all magical auras within sight and knows which creatures within 60 feet are spellcasters.

items.name: Extended Concentration
items.notes: The phaerimm can concentrate on two different spells at the same time. If concentration is broken, then both spells fade immediately.

items.name: Immutable Form
items.notes: The phaerimm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The phaerimm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Saemon casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Saemon makes three Handaxe attacks.

items.name: Handaxe
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

items.name: Arcane Shield
items.notes: Saemon conjures a swirling yellow barrier and until the start of his next turn he adds +5 to his AC, including against the triggering attack, and he takes no damage from magic missile.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Saemon wears a quiver of Ehlonna (holding 40 handaxes).

items.name: Hurl
items.notes: Saemon makes a ranged Handaxe attack.

items.name: Cast a Spell
items.notes: Saemon uses Spellcasting.

items.name: Animate Objects
items.notes: Saemon casts animate objects, targeting up to 10 handaxes he has thrown at enemies. If there are not 10 handaxes available, then he provides the remaining handaxes from his quiver of Ehlonna. Handaxes are Tiny objects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Sarevok casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Sarevok makes two Longsword attacks. He may replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

items.name: Longsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage or 10 (1d10 + 5) if wielded in two hands. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed by Bhaal. The cursed target can't regain hit points. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

items.name: Assassin's Strike
items.notes: Sarevok makes a Longsword attack. If he hits the target and has advantage on the attack roll, then he deals an additional 21 (6d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 10 minutes.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Sarevok has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Rejuvenation
items.notes: If Sarevok is killed he gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears on the altar of the temple of Bhaal beneath Baldur's Gate. This ability ceases to function if a cleric of good alignment casts Hallow on the altar in the temple of Bhaal.

items.name: Attack
items.notes: Sarevok makes a Longsword attack.

items.name: Unholy Flame
items.notes: Sarevok casts sacred flame.

items.name: Channel Bhaal's Hate
items.notes: Sarevok unleashes Bhaal's power. Creatures within 30 feet of Sarevok, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of Sarevok's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The shator casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

conditional.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The shator makes one Bite attack or one Poisonous Spit attack (if available) and then makes two Claws attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

items.name: Claws
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

items.name: Poisonous Spit
items.notes: The shator exhales poisonous spit in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) acid damage on a failed save and having the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Summon Demodand
items.notes: The shator rolls a d6. A result of 1-2 summons in two allied farastu stalkers, a result of 3-4 summons in one allied shator warden.

items.name: Poisonous Slime
items.notes: When hit with a melee attack, the shator expels a toxic slime. The attacker must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or have the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Devil's Sight
items.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shator's darkvision.

items.name: Keen Smell
items.notes: The shator has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The shator has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
items.notes: The shator's weapon attacks are magical.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The sirene casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The sirene makes two Dagger attacks or two Shortbow attacks.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

items.name: Shortbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

items.name: Sirene's Song
items.notes: The sirene casts suggestion with a range of 1 mile that affects all creatures of the sirene's choosing in range. Each target has disadvantage on the saving throw.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The sirene can breathe air and water.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The sirene has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Skeleton Lord
languages: all the languages it knew in life

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The skeleton lord makes three Greatsword attacks.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

items.name: Fear Aura
items.notes: Any creature hostile to the skeleton lord that starts its turn within 20 feet of the skeleton lord must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, unless the skeleton lord is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature has the frightened condition until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, then the creature is immune to the skeleton lord's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The skeleton lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
items.notes: The skeleton lord's weapon attacks are magical and gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls (included in the attack).

name: Skeleton Warrior

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The skeleton warrior has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
items.notes: The skeleton warrior's weapon attacks are magical and gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls (included in the attack).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Ssendam casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Ssendam makes three attacks: one with her Touch of Madness and two with her Chaos Staff.

items.name: Touch of Madness
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A target that fails a DC 20 Charisma saving throw is inflicted with a random short-term madness. If it is already mad, the existing madness is replaced with a random long-term madness.

items.name: Chaos Staff
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Summon Slaadi
items.notes: Ssendam summons 1d4 + 1 death slaad. A summoned slaad appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Ssendam, acts as an ally of Ssendam, and can't summon other slaadi. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Ssendam dies, or until Ssendam dismisses it as an action.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Ssendam magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

items.name: Change Shape
items.notes:
Ssendam polymorphs into a Small or Medium-sized Humanoid, into a Small Aberration that looks like a golden amoeba, or back into this, her golden slaad form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies. Her statistics in the Humanoid forms, other than her size, are the same.

While in her amoeba form, Ssendam also has the same statistics with the following changes. She can't take any actions (except her Change Shape action), speak, or manipulate objects. She has a movement speed of 40 feet and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, Ssendam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. She has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws, and has resistance to all damage except psychic and radiant.

items.name: Amoeba
items.notes: When damaged, Ssendam uses her reaction to activate Change Shape to transform into her golden amoeba form. Doing this reduces the damage to 0.

items.name: Aura of Madness
items.notes: Any creature (other than Undead or Constructs) that ends its turn within 10 feet of Ssendam must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be inflicted with a random short-term madness. If a creature succeeds against any madness ability of Ssendam's, they are immune to Ssendam's madness for 1 hour.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Ssendam fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Ssendam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Magic Weapons
items.notes: Ssendam's weapon attacks are magical.

items.name: Regeneration (Golden Amoeba Form Only)
items.notes: Ssendam regains 40 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point.

items.name: Chaos Staff
items.notes: Ssendam makes one Chaos Staff attack.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Ssendam uses her Teleport action.

items.name: Subversion (Costs 2 Actions)
items.notes: Ssendam forces every creature suffering from madness within 60 feet of her to use their reaction to attack another creature within 5 feet of them.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

items.name: Bronze Bolt
items.notes: ms,rs +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) lightning damage.

items.name: Explosion
items.notes: Suldil discharges a burst of energy in a 60-foot-radius. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) lightning damage on failed save, half as much damage on a successful save.

items.name: Mounted
items.notes: If Suldil isn't mounted, she can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto her young bronze dragon mount, provided Suldil and the young bronze dragon are on the same plane of existence. When she teleports, Suldil appears astride the young bronze dragon along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, Suldil can't be surprised, and both her and her mount gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

items.name: Young Bronze Dragon
items.notes: Suldil is accompanied by a young bronze dragon. The dragon allows Suldil to use him as a mount.

items.notes: The sword spider makes one Bite attack and two Foreleg attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and has the paralyzed condition while poisoned in this way.

items.name: Foreleg
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The sword spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Web Sense
items.notes: While in contact with a web, the sword spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

items.name: Web Walker
items.notes: The sword spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Net

A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature in a net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

items.name: Javelin
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Javelin Expert
items.notes: Tasloi can use their Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with a javelin, just as if the javelin had the finesse property.

items.name: Nimble Escape
items.notes: The tasloi can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

items.name: Blowgun
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 25/100 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1 + 4) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 hour.

items.name: Javelin
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

items.name: Javelin Expert
items.notes: Tasloi can use their Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with a javelin, just as if the javelin had the finesse property.

items.name: Nimble Escape
items.notes: The tasloi can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Tiberius Inuus makes three Flame Tongue attacks.

items.name: Flame Tongue
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

items.name: Touch of Sune
items.notes: Tiberius Inuus touches a creature. The target magically regains 40 hit points and is freed from any disease or poison.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Xzar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks): *Necromancy spell of 1st level or higher

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Xzar makes two Deprive attacks and uses Spellcasting.

items.name: Deprive
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack Roll: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) necrotic damage.

items.name: Death Eruption
items.notes: Negative energy erupts from Xzar, intensified by the Chaos Phage. Any creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere around Xzar (but not including Xzar) must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 36 (8d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this ability rises at the start of Xzar's next turn as a zombie under his command.

items.name: Chaos Phage
items.notes:
Xzar's infusion with the Chaos Phage gives him the following benefits:

• Xzar regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point
• Xzar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects
• Xzar has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder
• Xzar has darkvision and telepathy to 60 feet

items.name: Grim Harvest
items.notes: When Xzar kills a creature that is neither a Construct nor Undead with a spell of 1st level or higher, Xzar regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level, or three times if it is a necromancy spell.

items.name: No Soul
items.notes: Since Xzar doesn't have a soul, resurrection magic is able to work upon him no matter how much time has passed. For example, the revivify spell would work on Xzar even a week after he died. However, spells like true resurrection and wish are unable to bring Xzar back to life if no body exists.
